name: copilot
specialty: GitHub-integrated assistant useful for implementation and security-focused review.
notes: Repo-wide review can fail with "Static system messages and tool definitions exceed the model's usable context budget". roster.py classify reports it as context-budget; the reviewer:security seat then falls back to grok for that run when grok is usable.
Headless needs -p (prompt mode exits after one answer) and --no-ask-user, or the CLI waits for input; stdin is /dev/null. Copilot CLI 1.0.102.

Reviewers deny shell and write; builders may write (--allow-tool=write) but get no shell: the lead runs tests and commits. Deny rules beat allow rules, including --allow-all-tools (copilot help permissions).
A spent monthly quota prints "You have exceeded your monthly quota (Request ID: ...)" and exits 1; classify reports it as unavailable for the run and the security seat goes to grok.
